ruleStatus: The provision that would shorten this window to December 15 — 45 CFR 155.410(e)(5), added by the 2025 Marketplace Integrity and Affordability final rule (90 FR 27074) — was vacated by the U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland on 2026-06-12 in City of Columbus v. Kennedy, No. 1:25-cv-2114. The window therefore stands at November 1 through January 15. The government's appeal, 4th Cir. No. 26-1938, was argued 2026-10-30 and is undecided, so the dates can change.
stateNote: State-based Marketplaces set their own enrollment dates, which can differ from HealthCare.gov.

subsidyStatus.basis: IRC 36B(c)(1)(E) suspends the 400%-of-FPL cap only for taxable years beginning before 2026-01-01. IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-26 section 3.01 publishes a 2027 applicable percentage table whose final bracket ends at 400% of FPL, so the pre-ARPA schedule and the 400% cliff govern plan year 2027.
subsidyStatus.congressRecord: H.R. 1834 (House-passed 3-year extension, 230-196 on 2026-01-08) sits on the Senate calendar with no floor action; H.R. 5145 remains 'Introduced', its only action being referral to the House Committee on Ways and Means.
